notes.title: 10 New Heroes Join the Battle!
notes.content:
The war intensifies in Epic of Brave as we proudly announce the arrival of 10 new heroes, bringing the total number of heroes to 25! This major update expands the roster with new warriors, tacticians, and spellcasters, offering players fresh gameplay opportunities and strategies. Whether you're a veteran or a newcomer, there's never been a better time to join the fight.

Meet the New Heroes:

🛠️ Dwarf Engineer
A mechanical genius, the Dwarf Engineer specializes in constructing powerful turrets and explosives. His strategic mind and mechanical creations make him an invaluable asset on the battlefield, providing both offensive firepower and defensive support.

🎩 Human Stealth
A master of deception and stealth, the Human Stealth excels at moving unnoticed through the shadows. With enhanced agility and a deadly array of surprise attacks, he can infiltrate enemy lines and eliminate high-value targets before they even realize he's there.

🤖 Machine Guard
A towering, mechanized warrior, the Machine Guard is equipped with heavy armor and devastating weaponry. His advanced technology allows him to take damage with ease while dishing out punishing attacks, making him a perfect tank and powerhouse.

🔮 Human Riftwalker
The Human Riftwalker bends time and space, using his rift powers to teleport across the battlefield. His ability to manipulate dimensions grants him unmatched mobility, allowing him to reposition or escape danger in the blink of an eye.

🔥 Dwarf Pyrotechnic
An explosive expert, the Dwarf Pyrotechnic thrives in the heat of battle. Armed with powerful bombs and fire-based attacks, he can cause massive destruction, controlling enemy movements and creating chaos wherever he goes.

✨ Elf Illusionist
A master of illusionary magic, the Elf Illusionist can confuse and deceive his enemies, leaving them disoriented and vulnerable. His ability to create powerful illusions makes him a formidable support hero, tricking enemies into mistakes and confusion.

🦦 Orc Seeker
A relentless tracker, the Orc Seeker uses his heightened senses to hunt down enemies with precision. His skills focus on reducing enemy defenses and dealing devastating attacks when his prey is cornered, making him an expert in both survival and offense.

🧪 Human Alchemist
A skilled master of potions, the Human Alchemist uses his vast knowledge to brew elixirs that can heal allies or harm enemies. His concoctions are powerful tools, giving him the ability to boost his team’s abilities or unleash devastating poisons on his foes.

💀 Orc Phantom
The Orc Phantom is a stealthy and deadly force, capable of phasing in and out of visibility. His ability to slip past enemies and deal critical strikes from the shadows makes him an excellent assassin, capable of eliminating high-priority targets with ease.

🌿 Elf Mindweaver
The Elf Mindweaver controls the minds of others with her telepathic powers. Whether manipulating enemies or boosting allies, her abilities to control the battlefield make her a versatile hero capable of turning the tide of any conflict through mental domination.

What’s New in This Update?

With these 10 new heroes, the battlefield has become even more diverse, giving players even more ways to strategize. Whether you prefer powerful ranged attacks, stealthy maneuvers, or supportive abilities, these heroes have something for everyone.

Highlights of the Update:

25 Heroes Total: A rich variety of champions, each with unique skills and abilities.
New Playstyles: Use the new heroes to explore new tactics, combos, and counterplay.
Updated Meta: The new heroes are designed to shake up the meta, creating exciting new team compositions.
Get Ready for the Battle!

Update your game now and take your team into battle with these new powerful heroes. With Epic of Brave’s ever-growing roster, the possibilities are endless. Will you rise as the ultimate champion?

We thank you for your support and look forward to seeing how you utilize these new heroes to dominate the battlefield.

notes.title: Unleash the Battlegrounds: Six New Heroes Arrive in Epic of Brave!
notes.content:
We're excited to unveil a massive update for Epic of Brave, now live! Introducing six incredible heroes to our lineup, this update not only expands your choices for combat but also brings fresh tactics and challenges to the battlefield.

Meet the New Heroes!

Mortred - Elf Assassin
Mortred, the enigmatic Elf Assassin, is a master of the shadows known across the lands for his dual blades of doom. With each swift and silent step, he moves like a ghost, delivering death with unmatched precision. Mortred's twin swords have tasted the blood of countless foes, ensuring that for his enemies, escape is nothing more than a fleeting illusion.
[previewyoutube=txUx_MSkO9Q;full][/previewyoutube]
Flavius - Human Centurion
Flavius, the stalwart Centurion of the Imperial Legion, is the living embodiment of discipline and an unwavering defense. With a shield as steadfast as the mountains and a spirit forged in the fires of countless battles, he leads the charge, a relentless wall against any adversary. His presence on the battlefield inspires courage, making him an indomitable force against darkness.
[previewyoutube=FuVVn5qNCsI;full][/previewyoutube]
El'Dar - Elf Druid
El'Dar, the revered Elf Druid, serves as the Warden of the Whispering Glade. He commands the ancient magics of the forest, weaving together the fury and serenity of nature itself. With every spell, he can heal allies or ensnare foes, manipulating the battlefield with the ease of the winds and the growth of the woods. His powers restore balance and bring harmony amidst the chaos of war.
[previewyoutube=PLBIQqL4SVo;full][/previewyoutube]
Shade - Dark Wizard
Shade, the formidable Dark Wizard, is a master of forbidden arts, wielding shadow magic that no mortal dare confront. His command over the dark elements strikes terror into the hearts of his enemies, bending the very essence of fear to his will. Shade's presence on the battlefield is marked by a chilling air and the ominous echo of power that follows his every incantation.
[previewyoutube=qgrf8hHY3AY;full][/previewyoutube]
Celine - Elf Healer
Celine, the divine Elf Healer, is a guardian angel blessed by the mystical Moonwells of Elvenesse. Her healing touch not only mends the deepest wounds but also rekindles the dwindling spirits of her comrades. With every pulse of her healing light, Celine reinforces the will to fight, weaving hope and vitality through the ranks of those who stand for good.
[previewyoutube=7wEcrrf08qc;full][/previewyoutube]
Zul'Chakra - Orc Shaman
Zul'Chakra, the fierce Orc Shaman, speaks with the voices of the ancestral spirits. His command over the elemental forces is both awe-inspiring and terrifying, bringing forth the raw power of earth, wind, fire, and water to smite his foes or shield his allies. As a beacon of primal might, Zul'Chakra balances destruction with resilience, making him a pivotal force in any conflict.
[previewyoutube=yMifIra195o;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Epic of Brave : Release
notes.content:
🌟Unleash Your Legend: Epic of Brave!🌟

Calling all heroes! Are you ready to forge your destiny in a world of epic battles, strategic depth, and boundless customization? Then prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure with Epic of Brave, the exhilarating new MOBA that's now available on Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840953/44c527509983b2132f25d65de43be886f6b30d6d.png

In Epic of Brave, you'll:

✨Dominate the Arena: Master the art of MOBA combat in thrilling 1v1 or 3v3 battles. Coordinate with your team, devise cunning strategies, and unleash devastating abilities to crush your opponents.

🗺️Craft Your Champion: Delve into a deep character creation system. Choose from a diverse roster of heroes, each with unique strengths and weaknesses. Customize their appearance, hone their skills, and forge legendary weapons to suit your playstyle.

🏰Become a Master of Magic: Command a vast arsenal of potent spells. Combine different abilities to create devastating combos and dominate the battlefield. Experiment and discover the perfect build to lead your team to victory.

🔥Experience the Campaign: Embark on a captivating narrative alongside your fellow heroes. Unravel the mysteries of the world, complete challenging quests, and earn valuable rewards to empower your champions.

Epic of Brave offers:

🎉Fast-Paced Action: Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-pumping thrill of MOBA combat.

🔮Strategic Depth: Devise cunning tactics, outmaneuver your opponents, and claim victory through superior strategy.

👉Endless Customization: Forge your legend with a vast array of character options, weapons, and abilities.

🛡️A Thriving Community: Join a passionate community of players and forge lasting friendships on the battlefield.

Ready to answer the call? Download Epic of Brave on Steam today and write your own epic saga!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840953/2cad92128b95f05a448bcf1b68467224697404de.jpg

We're incredibly excited to welcome you to the world of Epic of Brave. Your feedback during this Early Access phase is invaluable to us as we continue to refine and expand the game. Together, let's create a MOBA experience that stands the test of time.

Thank you for your support, and see you on the battlefield!

— The Epic of Brave Team
